title: Multidimensional rollout lattice and autorepair advisor
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Summary: Design and deliver a multidimensional 'lattice' view in Console for rollout observability that surfaces per-route deltas across latency, cost, and quality simultaneously, plus an 'Autorepair Advisor' that simulates and recommends circuit-breaker style interventions (graceful degrade, route pin, staged revert) before executing an auto-repair policy. This ticket scopes the PM deliverables, UX guardrails, and acceptance criteria; ENG tickets will implement telemetry, trace linking, and rollback hooks.

Goals: 
- Provide a compact, explorable lattice that shows cohorts on X/Y/Z axes (e.g., latency P95, cost per 1k tokens, quality regression score) so PMs and SREs can quickly identify multi-metric regressions.
- Allow users to pivot dimensions, pin routes, and open trace-linked drilldowns for sample requests contributing to the delta.
- Integrate shadow-traffic samplers and ghost traffic playback to replay divergent inputs into candidate variants.
- Autorepair Advisor: run deterministic simulations of circuit-breaker thresholds (traffic shed, isolate variant, fallback route) and surface expected customer impact and cost delta. Tie to optional auto-repair policies with human-in-the-loop approvals.

Progress & decisions made so far: 
- 2026-02-20: Kickoff with ENG & Design. Agreed lattice should be rendered as small multiples with color-coding for significance and arrow badges for directionality of change. (Design doc v1: https://confluence.redwood.ai/rollout/lattice-v1)
- 2026-02-26: Prototype wireframe reviewed by Design (Ava Kim) and SRE (Noah Ortega). Feedback: require fast toggles for dimension selection and a way to persist favorite lattice views per-team.
- 2026-03-03: Trade-off: rich per-token quality signals (LLM evals) are expensive to compute in real-time; decided to surface precomputed sample-set regressions for the lattice and allow on-demand rerun of golden prompt suites when users click into a cohort. ENG to add an async 'rerun-eval' job.
- 2026-03-08: Telemetry schema agreed: cohort_id, route_id, model_variant, metric_name, window_start, window_end, pct_change, baseline_mean, variant_mean, sample_count. ENG-83421 to add these to rollout metrics pipeline.

Open design questions / trade-offs: 
- Auto vs. manual action: default behavior will be advisory (show recommended autorepair actions) and require explicit enablement at org level for automated enforcement. This minimizes accidental rollbacks while allowing enterprise customers to opt-in.
- Simulation fidelity: the advisor uses traffic-weighted historical windows. For very small-cohort canaries (<1% traffic) simulation has low statistical power; we will surface confidence intervals and recommend minimum sample sizes.
- UX density: balancing information density in the lattice versus readability — prioritizing compact trend sparkbars and hovercards with top contributing endpoints.

Acceptance criteria: 
1) Lattice view available in Console for any active rollout with controls to select 3 dimensions and time window.
2) Clicking a lattice cell opens a side-pane with top traces, sample requests, and a link to shadow-replay lab.
3) Autorepair Advisor can simulate three actions (traffic-shed to baseline, variant-pin, staged-revert) and provide estimated customer impact and cost delta.
4) Audit log entries created for any user-run autorepair simulation and for any executed auto-repair policy.
5) End-to-end e2e test: create a synthetic canary with injected latency and quality regressions and confirm lattice flags significant cells and advisor recommends sane repair.

Next steps / immediate TODOs:

- [ ] Design: finalize lattice color/shape language and mobile fallback (owner: Ava Kim). Due: 2026-03-19.

Risks and mitigations: 
- Risk: noisy signals from low-sample cohorts. Mitigation: surface confidence intervals and require min sample count to enable auto-repair.
- Risk: accidental automated rollbacks. Mitigation: opt-in at org/team level and human approval gating for P0 services. Audit logs + revert playbook included.

Testing & QA: 
- Create test harness that generates synthetic traffic with controlled deltas across latency/quality/cost. Validate lattice highlights and adviser simulation outputs match expected.
- Add regression tests for trace-linking and shadow-replay verification.

Notes from last review (2026-03-11):

- Design feedback: For accessibility, ensure colorblind-safe palettes and patterned fills for severity bands.
- ENG feedback: Need to ensure the lattice generation scales for orgs with hundreds of routes; will implement server-side pagination and pre-agg rollups.
